resources.string: Folders, with rsync: only what changed is sent
Whole system, as one archive that Import restores
Install rsync in %1$s if it is missing (apt-get install rsync)

rsync must also be on the server. The folders keep their paths there, like root/… and home/…, and nothing on the server is deleted. TermiNow logs in with the key, passphrase and jump host of the server.

All of %1$s goes into one .tar.gz on the server, named with the date. To restore it, copy it to the phone and use Add workspace → Import. Close other tabs of %1$s first, so files do not change while they are read.
Add the server you back up to as an SSH host first, with its key or password.
A folder like terminow-backups/ubuntu or ~/backups, without spaces or ..
Folders that start with /, separated by spaces, like /root /home
A backup to the phone is running already
Stop the backup? The unfinished file is deleted.
From a .tar.gz that Back up to phone storage or proot-distro backup saved
Restoring %3$s replaces %1$s (%2$s): all of its files now are deleted, and the files of the backup take their place.
%2$s is a backup of %1$s, which is not installed. It is restored as the environment %1$s.
I understand that the files in %1$s now are replaced
